Old Shore Wharf (Japanese: カントー波止場 Kanto Wharf) is an -exclusive dock in Kanto. It appeared in Mewtwo Strikes Back and its remake. works here as a pier master.
 ]]
In the , , and got an invitation from a . The invitation included a hologram of a Nurse Joy, hypnotized by , who told them that Mewtwo was waiting for them on New Island and they would be able to reach it from Old Shore Wharf.

When they arrived at Old Shore Wharf, they were told that the boats to New Island wouldn't leave, because of the stormy weather conditions, which were caused by Mewtwo.
